caption: The drawing displays two metallic objects rendered in grayscale pencil on a rectangular, off-white sheet. The main object, depicted in the foreground and occupying the left half of the drawing, is a conical vessel with a spout at its narrow end, a flared rim at the wide end, and two handles with decorative curves attached to its side. The vessel is lying on its side, casting a shadow beneath it toward the bottom left. The surface of this object is shaded to indicate a metallic texture, with areas of irregular speckling to represent reflection or tarnish. In the upper right portion of the image, a second, smaller cylindrical object is shown from the top view. This object has a circular opening with a small handle, and its base is perforated with multiple small holes arranged in a roughly circular pattern. The background is plain with no distinguishing features except for a faint rectangular border surrounding the objects. A handwritten notation "900" and an illegible word are located in the lower left corner within the border.
title: Strainer with Funnel
